domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
m is an integer and 0 <= m <= n - 1
t is a real number and m / n <= t
t is a real number and t < (m + 1) / n
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n > 1, for all integers m with 0 <= m <= n - 1, and for all real numbers t with m divided by n <= t and t < (m + 1) divided by n, the floor of n times t equals m.

variables.name: n
variables.role: parameter controlling the scaling in floor(n * t)

variables.name: t
variables.role: input constrained to an interval determined by n and m

witness_dependencies: There are no existential witnesses; the statement is purely universal.

statement_nl: Let n be an integer with n > 1, let m be an integer with 0 <= m <= n - 1, and let t be a real number satisfying m / n <= t < (m + 1) / n. Then floor(n * t) = m.
